messages:
acme_jane: Hey team — after today's model bump (model=v3.2.0) our assistant responses feel more 'measured' and are dropping the worked examples and step-by-step scaffolding we used to get. Not a crash but a regression in helpfulness for our docs flows. Sharing one quick repro below.

marta_support: Sorry to hear that — can you paste a short repro prompt and the before/after outputs? Request IDs help if you have them.

acme_jane: Prompt:
"How do I reset a user's password via API?"

Before (v3.1.7):
"You can reset a user's password by calling POST /admin/users/:id/reset with a JSON body. Example steps:
1) curl -X POST https://api.example.com/admin/users/123/reset -d '{\"send_email\":true}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer TOKEN'
2) Check 200 and email delivery.
3) If you want to set a temp password, call PATCH /admin/users/123 with {\"password\":\"tempPass123\"}."

After (v3.2.0):
"Use the admin.reset endpoint. See docs."

Request IDs: req-8a1f, req-8a33

sam_engineer: thanks — looping in @diego_research. Can you also include exact API kwargs you used (max_tokens, temperature, system prompt, top_p, any streaming)?

acme_jane: max_tokens=300, temperature=0.2, top_p=0.95, system="You are a helpful assistant that gives concrete examples and code snippets", no streaming.

diego_research: quick FYI — there was a kernel/table-kernel update and we pushed a quantization profile change with v3.2.0 canary. @deploy-bot did the canary earlier, can you confirm window?

deploy-bot: Canary rollout: models:v3.2.0 started at 2359001000 -> 2359004000, traffic=12% (canary).

sam_engineer: Reproduced locally with the exact params. I ran:
``
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"model":"v3.2.0","input":"How do I reset a user's password via API?","max_tokens":300,"temperature":0.2}'
```
Response is terse and drops the multi-step example; the reply truncates around token ~120. No API errors.

diego_research: initial hypotheses: (1) a decoding/penalty config shifted to prefer shorter answers for safety; (2) quantization altered probabilities of lower-frequency tokens that appear in scaffolding text; (3) kernel changes affect KV cache cutoff heuristics and we lose some prefix context. We'll run an automated A/B eval vs v3.1.7.

marta_support: Customer is asking for either a rollback or a mitigation (restore example-rich responses). ETA on triage? Customer flagged production impact on onboarding flows.

diego_research: We'll run a targeted eval set (200 prompts covering docs/how-to and API walkthroughs) and compute delta on average response length, example count, and BLEU-like overlap. Expect initial results by EOD. Please add any representative prompts to the ticket.

acme_jane: I'll DM 4 more prompts that show the impact. Appreciate the quick attention.

sam_engineer: Filed ENG ticket INF-4367 (label: tone-regression_v3.2.0) with repro, request IDs, and curl snippet. Assigned to eng-ml.

diego_research: Quick request for support: if you have conversation-level system messages or prompt templating used by the customer, include them in the ticket — those can interact with decoding heuristics.

marta_support: Noted. I'll collect and update. Tagging #eng-ml and #product-observability. :eyes:

acme_jane: Thanks everyone — happy to provide whatever helps. :heart:

marta_support: following up with customer; will update thread when eng posts eval results.
